tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa ba ri lugs kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg sdug bsngal rab 'joms bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra bi dā ra ya/ gnyis med ye shes rdo rje yis/ /bdud sde rnam par 'joms byed pa/ /bla ma rig sngags rgyal btud nas/ /de mnyes zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bshad/ /rnam 'joms ba ri lugs kyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg la/ zhi ba'i thab khung spyi 'gre'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / thab kyi shar lhor me lha'i tshom bu dang me tshang ting lo/ kha sbyor la 'o ma can gyi shing ngam/ srog chags kyi lci ba gtsang ma zlum po mtho gang brtsigs pa dang me yol/ thab kyi g.yon nas yam shing / /mar til zas mchog dang / /so ba 'bras nas gro dang ni/ /sran ma dur wa ku sha rnams/ /thab g.yas chu gnyis nyer mchod dang / /'das gtor me lha cha gsum gtor/ /bsdu na 'das gtor me lha'o/ /rdor dril dgang blugs bsangs chu bcas bshams/ shar du blta ba sogs gzhan thams cad zhi ba spyi 'gre bzhin no/ /dngos gzhi la mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa nam mkhar phyung ste mchod bstod bzod gsol gyi bar ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam 'joms bum chog sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ spor lde sbar ste/ yang snying bzla bzhin pas thab la lan gsum bskor nas me sbar/ yang snying bzla bzhin pas mar dgang blugs kyi me kha gsos/ bsang chur dmigs nas yang snying nyer gcig sogs bzlas la/ g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i ku shas 'thor zhing sngags des bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ mchod pa byin rlabs bum chog bzhin la sreg rdzas rnams kyang gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba zhes sogs gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ sogs mchod sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pa dang / sreg rdzas la dmigs nas 'bru gsum nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa sogs ci rigs/

thab bsangs sbyangs gong bzhin dang / bskyed chog gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin la/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bud shing brtsigs pa dang bcas par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes brjod la thab byin gyis brlabs/ thab kyi dbus su pad+ma'i gdan la raṃ las me lha bskyed chog gzhan bzhin la/ g.yas pa gnyis mchog sbyin dang bgrang 'phreng / g.yon pa gnyis dbyu gu gsum pa ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ gzhan 'dra/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas zhes sogs dang / dbyu gu'i phyag rgya/ spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad sogs gzhan bzhin brjod pa'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ bsdu rgya se gol gyis spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbastim/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab ma bshad/ spro na ku sha dang byon zan gzhan bzhin gyi mthar mchod bstod bya ba'am/ bsdu na mchod bstod/ yam shing nas ku sha'i bar gyi sreg rdzas rnams/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ kho nas phul mthar spel tshig mchod bstod gong bzhin/ mar dgang blugs dang / oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la raṃ/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ zhes 'jig rten pa dang 'das pa'i me lha ni/ mchod rdzas sreg rdzas me kha rnams gsos la/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su srung 'khor dang rdo rje rnam 'joms bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs spyan 'dren bstim/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab rnams sam/ spro na spyan 'dren gyi tshigs bcad bum chog bzhin dang dbang bskur rgyas btab kyi rjes su/ de nyid la rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ spro na nye snying sngon 'gro'i byon zan/ de rjes su mchod bstod/ bsdu na bum bskyed bzhin mchod bstod/ spro na mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs byas la/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho sogs tshigs bcad dang / mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i mchod pa/ bstod pa rgyas pa ci shes/

yam shing nas ku sha'i bar gyi bsreg rdzas rnams nye snying kho nas brgya rtsa sogs phul ba'i mthar spel tshig gshegs skyems byon zan bzhin mchod bstod/ gtor ma bum chog bzhin na/ bsdu na cha gsum ma btang kyang chog slar yang mchod bstod/ zhi ba'i 'dod gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor ba sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang / oṃ khyed kyis sogs/ oṃ badz+ra muḥdang / mtheb srin gyi se gol gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ thab thal nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis dpral bar cung zad bkus mar dgang blugs sngags gong bzhin gyi me lha zhal phyag gi rnam par gyur/ mchod bstod bsreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin dang / gshegs skyems byon zan bzhin/ slar yang mchod bstod/ gtor ma yang snying gis bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rin po che'i snod du bskyed pa sogs 'bul tshul dang mchod bstod 'dod gsol gzhan bzhin/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs sh+lo ka gcig spro na bdag gi don dang sogs sngags bcas sam/ bsdu na sngags kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ gnas gsum bsrung / bsngo smon shis brjod byas la dngos grub kyi don du me ma yal bar mi bsdu ba'am/ yang na 'o chab kyis zhi bar byas la/ 'phral du bsdu ba sogs spyi 'gre bzhin no/ /yang bsnyen pa'i kha skong yin na grangs bsnyen ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha'i sbyin sreg 'dzin phyir 'das pa'i me lhar bsreg rdzas 'bul ba'i skabs su til gyi grangs 'dzin dang / rdzas bcu gcig tshan du bcad nas 'bul ba sogs gzhan bzhin dang / gnas skabs kyi sbyin sreg la'ang rdzas gzhan ma 'byor na bcu gcig tsam re phul la til brgya rtsa phul bas las 'grub par mngon no/ ༈ /zhes chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis gsung gi gsal byed 'di yang gong gi rigs skyes sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis nyung ngu'i ngag gis bkod pa'i yi ge pa'ang kun blo gyis so//
